# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Failed flush cache cleanup**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.204/index.md)

## Highlights

The collected 4.152.4 changes prevent reuse of uninitialized cached textures after failed Ganesh flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clear failed-flush cache entries** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))
